title: Glowing umbrella
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- handle curved bottom -->
  <path d="M50 82 Q50 90 42 90 Q35 90 35 83" fill="none" stroke="#FF6EC7" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- shaft -->
  <line x1="50" y1="42" x2="50" y2="82" stroke="#FFD93D" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- umbrella canopy panels -->
  <path d="M50 42 Q30 42 18 55 Q32 52 50 42Z" fill="#FF6EC7"/>
  <path d="M50 42 Q40 44 30 58 Q40 54 50 42Z" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <path d="M50 42 Q60 44 70 58 Q60 54 50 42Z" fill="#4DD0E1"/>
  <path d="M50 42 Q70 42 82 55 Q68 52 50 42Z" fill="#B388FF"/>
  <!-- canopy scalloped bottom edge -->
  <path d="M18 55 Q22 62 30 58 Q38 64 50 58 Q62 64 70 58 Q78 62 82 55" fill="none" stroke="#FF6EC7" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- glow highlights on canopy -->
  <path d="M28 48 Q34 45 40 44" fill="none" stroke="#FFE082" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M60 46 Q66 46 72 48" fill="none" stroke="#80F7FF" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- top ferrule -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="40" r="3" fill="#FFD93D"/>
  <!-- glow aura around canopy -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="36" ry="20" fill="#FF6EC7" opacity="0.12"/>
  <!-- sparkles around umbrella -->
  <circle cx="20" cy="30" r="2" fill="#FFD93D" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="80" cy="32" r="2" fill="#4DD0E1" opacity="0.9"/>
  <circle cx="14" cy="70" r="1.8" fill="#B388FF" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="86" cy="68" r="1.8" fill="#FFD93D" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#FF6EC7" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
